properties.name: The sweep reports what the parked-idea rules skipped, instead of dropping it silently
properties.rationale:
🛑 THIS FIXES A DEFECT THE PARKED-IDEA WORK ITSELF INTRODUCED, CAUGHT BEFORE IT MERGED. Making three finding kinds read `is_parked_idea` took reflow2's own design from 89 to 61 defects, and nothing anywhere said the missing findings had been suppressed. A reader seeing 61 could not tell it from a design that genuinely has 61 — which is exactly the vacuous zero `SweepScope.parked` was built to prevent, reintroduced one rule over BY THE CHANGE THAT WAS FIXING IT.

`art:heal` realizes `cap:a-sweep-says-what-it-could-not-have-found`, and the sibling `parks` mechanism COUNTS parked nodes rather than silencing them. The new rule now does the same, so the two deliberate-state mechanisms behave alike instead of one reporting and one hiding.

⭐ IT IS A `swept.` FIGURE, NOT A DEFECT TALLY, and that distinction is load-bearing rather than cosmetic. The complaint that started this whole thread was that a DEFECT count grew when you brainstormed, which teaches people to stop reading it. A description of what the sweep did not look at costs a brainstormer nothing and lets an auditor reconstruct the total.

⚠️ THE COUNTERWEIGHT PIN IS THE ONE THAT MAKES THE FIELD TRUSTWORTHY. `a_clean_sweep_reports_nothing_suppressed` asserts the map is EMPTY when nothing was parked — without it, a wired-but-never-incremented field reads exactly like a design with no parked ideas, which is the same failure mode wearing the new field's clothes. It was written deliberately: the implementation was landed with the plumbing but WITHOUT the increments, the pin was run and went red for that reason, and only then were the three increment sites added.

📌 WHERE THE NUMBERS DIFFER AND WHY, so nobody reconciles them wrongly: the 89 -> 61 delta is 28, while the suppression count on the same design reads 33. Both are right — the graph grew by three brainstormed Decisions and four relations between the two measurements, and those added suppressible findings. The reconciliation that holds at any instant is `reported + suppressed`, not a delta against an older count.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: `SweepScope.suppressed_by_parked_idea` added — findings NOT reported because a parked idea was involved, counted by category. Measured on reflow2's own design the same day: 61 reported + 33 suppressed (contradiction 3, unresolved_setup 27, unthreaded_cluster 3), so the total reconciles instead of 33 findings vanishing. Threaded as an accumulator through `all_defects` / `open_defects_counting` / `detect_structural_defects` so the detectors count AS THEY SKIP — the count is never recomputed, because a second copy of the skip rule would drift from the first. Two new pins (14 tests total); core suite 1504 passed / 0 failed across 130 binaries; toolsnaps unchanged, since this is a result shape rather than a tool schema.
